newsitem.title: USA: Manor Care names management of Choice Hotels.
newsitem.headline: Manor Care names management of Choice Hotels.

text.p: Manor Care Inc said Wednesday it named William Floyd as vice chairman and chief executive officer of the soon-to-be spun off entity Choice Hotels International Inc, expected to start trading November 1 under the symbol.
Floyd is currently Chief Operating Officer of Taco Bell Corp, a subsidiary of PepsiCo.
Manor Care also said it named James MacCutcheon executive vice president and chief financial officer of Choice.
For the last nine years, MacCutcheon has held the CFO position for Manor Care.
September 30 Manor Care approved the separation of its lodging business from its health care business via a tax-free spin off of the lodging division to Manor Care shareholders.
On November 1 Manor Care shareholders will receive one share of Choice Hotels for every share of Manor Care stock held on October 10.
